articleBody:
Selling a luxury condo isn't just about putting a 'For Sale' sign out; it's a strategic process that requires meticulous preparation to capture the attention of discerning buyers. This checklist will help you cover all your bases before your property hits the market, ensuring a smooth and successful transaction.

- [ ] Gather all association documents — why these are essential for buyer transparency, including budgets, reserve information, and recent board minutes. 
- [ ] Obtain details on any special assessments — why buyers need to know about these upfront to avoid surprises and potential deal breakers. 
- [ ] Collect insurance information for the building and unit — why this provides crucial peace of mind for prospective owners regarding coverage and costs. 
- [ ] Document all permits for renovations or alterations — why unpermitted work can cause legal issues and delays during closing. 
- [ ] Arrange professional staging and photography/video — why high-quality visuals are non-negotiable for attracting luxury buyers and showcasing your unit's best features. 
- [ ] Confirm and clarify all showing restrictions — why clear access guidelines are important for accommodating qualified buyers efficiently. 
- [ ] Review comparable sales data (active, pending, closed) — why a hyper-accurate pricing strategy is based on understanding the true market value of similar units, factoring in stack, floor, and views.
- [ ] Address any needed repairs or deferred maintenance — why even small issues can detract from a luxury impression and signal larger problems to buyers.

How to use this checklist: Go through each item methodically, starting several weeks before your anticipated listing date. This preparation phase is crucial for addressing potential buyer questions before they even arise and presenting your condo in its absolute best light. A well-prepared listing instills confidence and can lead to a quicker, more profitable sale. Ready to get started? Let’s connect to refine your checklist and personalize your selling strategy.
